gamefaqs.product: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

format: byte-identical to GameFAQs 1263 (same uploader): DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak with one GameShark cart-save note "ZLZL" (3BADD1E5/FADE), 24 pages: length 0x8000 + LZARI stream of the 32 KiB SRAM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-1998.1260.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD wrong in every copy, rewritten as 0101/FEF1; cart-save note 'ZLZL' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): LZARI, 6054 bytes -> 32768

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder
